comments.author: Egw
comments.body: I just tried this IQ for the first time a few days ago and I found it to be a very well hidden gem. It's not hard to beat, gives good exp at high levels (each solo fight 800 - 1200 exp, 3-4 to complete the quest), works well towards grinding cannon skills (re-maxing refined gunnery in my case), they're fun fights in your backyard and to top it all up you get some PAs for your effort (I'm getting 14 when having the Oxford skill loaded). Give it a try if you're after cannon skills.
